title: Transcription Service Tests
requirements: Add controllable mocks for SpeechTranscriber and WhisperClient via protocol injection (or @testable internal types) — not real SFSpeechRecognizer / URLSession
Write `testSpeechTranscriber_PartialCompleted_FinalEmitted` that asserts exactly one .final TranscriptUpdate after .partial updates
Write `testWhisperFallback_WhenSpeechReturnsEmpty_WhisperRuns` that mocks Speech returning empty text and asserts the final TranscriptSource == .whisper
Write `testWhisperFallback_WhenSpeechFails_WhisperRuns` that mocks a Speech throw and asserts Whisper is invoked and the final source == .whisper
Write `testBothFailed_FailedUpdateEmitted` that mocks both engine failures and asserts a TranscriptUpdate.failed is emitted with no .final
Write `testSpeechSucceeds_NoWhisperFallback` that mocks Speech success and asserts Whisper.transcribe is never called (verify via a call-count mock)
Use XCTest assertions throughout; mark the class @MainActor
Add CI job running `swift test --sanitize=thread` per ISSUE-003/018
acceptance_criteria: TranscriptionServiceTests pass with all four fallback-scenario tests passing: speech-only success, whisper-only success, speech-failed-fallback-to-whisper, both-failed
Tests assert exactly which engine runs and what the final TranscriptSource is
No tests hit the network, mic, or on-device SFSpeechRecognizer
